name: print-social-carousel-purple-pink-tech-diagonal-stripes
title: Purple/pink tech carousel with diagonal stripe accents
whatItIs: A five-tile Instagram carousel for a 'Minimal Tech' brand, using deep purple-to-pink gradients, thin circuit-line patterns, and diagonal magenta stripe blocks around a flat illustrated tech worker.
whatItMeans: Diagonal stripe blocks cutting across otherwise flat tiles inject energy and a tech/circuit feel without needing literal wiring diagrams on every panel.
techniques: cut diagonal accent stripes across one corner of a tile as a recurring structural motif
overlay thin circuit-board line patterns for subtle tech texture behind flat illustration
keep one consistent flat character illustration style across all tiles for brand continuity

vocabulary.definition: a decorative background texture resembling printed circuit board traces, evoking technology
